title: Research Ethics Overview
description: Master research ethics for AI by understanding the chain of evidence from protocol through post-publication conduct, and treat ethics as a working discipline rather than a paperwork exercise.

lessons.title: Research Ethics Overview
lessons.audioSummary: Master research ethics for AI by understanding the chain of evidence from protocol through post-publication conduct, and treat ethics as a working discipline rather than a paperwork exercise.

lessons.title: Lineage from Human-Subjects Research
lessons.audioSummary: Learn the historical lineage and practical operating model for AI research ethics, grounded in decades of human-subjects research protections and adapted for modern AI-specific challenges.

lessons.title: AI-Specific Extensions
lessons.audioSummary: Research ethics for AI extends from human-subjects protections through a practical chain of evidence and defensibility that runs from protocol design through post-publication conduct.

lessons.title: Operating Model
lessons.audioSummary: Learn how to operationalize research ethics in AI work through a chain of evidence and authority spanning protocol, consent, data handling, analysis, disclosure, publication, and post-publication conduct.

lessons.title: Operating Cadence
lessons.audioSummary: Master the seven-step operating cadence that turns research-ethics principles into concrete practices that protect participants and defend your work.

lessons.title: Maturity Model
lessons.audioSummary: Learn the maturity model for AI research ethics: a chain of evidence and authority from protocol through publication that operationalizes ethical practice in research teams.

title: Red Team Overview
description: AI red teaming is a disciplined defensive practice that chains threat models, probes, findings, and fixes together into an auditable and legally defensible program.

lessons.title: AI Red Teaming Overview
lessons.audioSummary: AI red teaming is a disciplined defensive practice that chains threat models, probes, findings, and fixes together into an auditable and legally defensible program.

lessons.title: Scope & Deliverables
lessons.audioSummary: Learn how to structure AI red-teaming engagements with proper scope, authorization, probes, findings, and disclosure to create defensible security programs that actually produce fixes.

lessons.title: Lineage from Classical Red Teaming
lessons.audioSummary: AI red teaming evolved from classical security and intelligence red teaming, and it works as a defensible chain of evidence linking authorization, threat models, probes, findings, severity ratings, and fixes.

lessons.title: Operating Model
lessons.audioSummary: Master the operating model for AI red teaming: a chain of evidence from authorization and abuse cases through probe design, finding severity, and engineering handoff that turns security assessments into durable fixes.

lessons.title: Operating Cadence
lessons.audioSummary: Learn the operating cadence framework for running defensible AI red-teaming programs that deliver real fixes, not just flashy findings.

lessons.title: Maturity Model
lessons.audioSummary: Learn the maturity model for AI red teaming: a disciplined chain of evidence from authorization through probe design, finding severity, engineering fix, and disclosure that turns defensive testing into durable security improvements.

title: Dg Overview
description: Data governance as a defensible chain of evidence and authority: policy, ownership, controls, metrics, and integration that connect evidence to business outcomes and survive regulatory scrutiny.

lessons.title: Data Governance Overview
lessons.audioSummary: Data governance as a defensible chain of evidence and authority: policy, ownership, controls, metrics, and integration that connect evidence to business outcomes and survive regulatory scrutiny.

lessons.title: Scope & Deliverables
lessons.audioSummary: Scope and Deliverables teaches you how to design and operate effective data governance by anchoring work in policy and ownership, engineering controls into platforms, and connecting governance investments to measurable business outcomes.

lessons.title: Lineage from EDM & Records Management
lessons.audioSummary: Data governance builds a defensible chain of evidence from policy through operations to audit trails, connecting controls to business outcomes and regulator-facing proof.

lessons.title: Operating Model
lessons.audioSummary: A data governance operating model is the practical framework that turns policies and ownership into defensible, platform-integrated controls that survive audits and drive business outcomes.

lessons.title: Operating Cadence
lessons.audioSummary: Learn how to build a data governance operating cadence that embeds policy, platform controls, and outcome-linked metrics into your organization's engineering and analytics workflows to avoid governance theater and survive regulatory scrutiny.

lessons.title: Maturity Model
lessons.audioSummary: Data governance maturity is built on a chain of policy, ownership, platform controls, and metrics that must close incidents and defend decisions to regulators and stakeholders.

title: Disclosure Overview
description: Master AI disclosure and provenance as a discipline—understanding what information different audiences need, how to deliver it across multiple layers, and why treating disclosure as a verifiable chain of evidence protects your organization against regulatory failure.

lessons.title: Disclosure & Provenance Overview
lessons.audioSummary: Master AI disclosure and provenance as a discipline—understanding what information different audiences need, how to deliver it across multiple layers, and why treating disclosure as a verifiable chain of evidence protects your organization against regulatory failure.

lessons.title: Scope & Deliverables
lessons.audioSummary: AI disclosure and provenance is a chain of evidence spanning source lineage, training data, model outputs, watermarks, labels, cards, and reports—all anchored to specific audiences and integrated into the engineering lifecycle.

lessons.title: Lineage from Broadcast / Publishing
lessons.audioSummary: AI disclosure and provenance require anchoring each disclosure in a specific audience, choosing the right layer of disclosure, engineering verifiability across a chain of evidence, and integrating disclosure into the product lifecycle rather than treating it as an afterthought.

lessons.title: Operating Model
lessons.audioSummary: Master AI disclosure and provenance as a discipline by treating it as a chain of evidence, using layered disclosure mechanisms anchored to specific audiences and regulatory requirements.

lessons.title: Operating Cadence
lessons.audioSummary: Operating cadence is the systematic, end-to-end discipline of anchoring AI disclosure decisions in audience needs, choosing the right disclosure layer, engineering verifiable evidence chains, and integrating disclosure throughout the engineering and release lifecycle.

lessons.title: Maturity Model
lessons.audioSummary: A practical maturity model for building AI disclosure and provenance as a defensible, auditable operating discipline across your organization.

title: Advanced Prompt Engineering
description: Learn how to structure production prompts as tunable systems rather than black boxes, using deliberate design choices around system messages, role definition, and hyperparameters to achieve reliable results at scale.

lessons.title: Start Skill
lessons.audioSummary: Learn how to structure production prompts as tunable systems rather than black boxes, using deliberate design choices around system messages, role definition, and hyperparameters to achieve reliable results at scale.

lessons.title: System vs User Messages
lessons.audioSummary: Learn how to use system and user messages strategically in LLM APIs to separate instructions from inputs, improve consistency, and build production-grade AI systems.

lessons.title: Output Contracts and JSON Mode
lessons.audioSummary: Learn how to use output contracts and JSON mode to get reliable, structured data from language models in production systems.

lessons.title: Prompt Chaining Patterns
lessons.audioSummary: Prompt chaining patterns is a production-grade technique for getting repeatable, reliable results from language models by treating prompt design as a tunable lever rather than a black box.

lessons.title: Debugging Bad Prompts
lessons.audioSummary: Learn how to systematically debug and improve your AI prompts by treating them as tunable levers rather than black boxes, with practical patterns used by production teams.

lessons.title: Versioning and Testing Prompts
lessons.audioSummary: Learn how to version and test prompts systematically to reliably improve AI system outputs in production.

title: Langgraph Agents
description: LangGraph fundamentals teaches you how to build stateful, graph-based agent workflows by understanding nodes, edges, routing, and the production patterns that separate reliable agents from demos.

lessons.title: LangGraph Fundamentals
lessons.audioSummary: LangGraph fundamentals teaches you how to build stateful, graph-based agent workflows by understanding nodes, edges, routing, and the production patterns that separate reliable agents from demos.

lessons.title: Nodes, Edges, and State
lessons.audioSummary: Learn how to structure LangGraph agents using nodes, edges, and state to build reliable, production-grade workflows.

lessons.title: Conditional Routing
lessons.audioSummary: Learn how conditional routing in LangGraph lets agents make intelligent decisions about which path to take next, turning a linear flow into an adaptive decision tree.

lessons.title: Checkpointing and Persistence
lessons.audioSummary: Learn why checkpointing and persistence matter in production agents, how they work mechanically, and the key decisions that separate reliable systems from demos.

lessons.title: Human-in-the-Loop with LangGraph
lessons.audioSummary: Learn how to build human-in-the-loop agent workflows with LangGraph that pause for human decisions, improving reliability and control in production AI systems.

lessons.title: LangGraph in Production
lessons.audioSummary: Learn how to build stateful, reliable agent workflows in production using LangGraph through careful design choices around state management, routing, persistence, and instrumentation.
